text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat to discuss efforts to save the peace process today. The talks will cover the outcome of meetings the Palestinian president held with Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy and Ehud Barak, leader of Israel's main opposition Labour party.
- Egypt's exports from oil and products rose 14 percent to $2,764 million in the financial year 1996/97, said Oil Minister Hamdi el-Banbi.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri decided to form a four-minister committee to prepare a bill on fighting thuggery.
- Agriculture Minister Youssef Wali says that most genetically-altered products are safe. The government will not allow the importation of harmful seeds or other agricultural products.
- The Suez Canal's revenue exceeded $1 billion last year, Chairman Ahmed Fadhel said.
